title: Subway Was America's Sandwich King. Chipotle Passed It.
source: Chipotle Mexican Grill annual total revenue from company 10-K filings: $4.48B (2017), $4.87B (2018), $5.59B (2019), $5.98B (2020), $7.55B (2021), $8.63B (2022), $9.87B (2023), $11.31B (2024). Subway US systemwide sales, as reported by QSR Magazine/Restaurant Business and Technomic trade data: approx $11.2B (2017), $10.9B (2018), $10.5B (2019), $8.4B (2020, pandemic-hit), $9.0B (2021), $9.18B (2022), $9.88B (2023), $9.5B (2024). Subway has closed stores for ten straight years from a 2015 peak of 27,000+ US locations; Chipotle's revenue overtook Subway's US system sales in 2024.
